# pve_ha_status (Data Source)

Cluster-wide HA stack status from `GET /cluster/ha/status/current` and `GET /cluster/ha/status/manager_status`, including quorum, the active master, per-node LRM entries, and HA-managed services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_ha_status" "current" {}

output "ha_quorate" {
  value = data.pve_ha_status.current.quorate
}

output "ha_master_node" {
  value = data.pve_ha_status.current.master_node
}

output "ha_services" {
  value = [for entry in data.pve_ha_status.current.entries : entry.sid if entry.type == "service"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Every status entry. Field relevance depends on the entry `type`: `quorum`, `master`, `lrm`, `service`, or `fencing`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Static identifier for the HA status index.
- `manager_status` (String) Raw HA manager status document from `GET /cluster/ha/status/manager_status`, serialized as JSON text. The pin declares this response only as a generic object (the CRM's internal status document), so the field set is version-dependent.
- `master_node` (String) Node currently running the HA master CRM, taken from the `master` status entry.
- `nodes` (List of String) Distinct node names seen across the status entries (master, LRM, and service entries).
- `quorate` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is currently quorate, taken from the `quorum` status entry.
- `quorum_status` (String) Raw status string of the `quorum` entry (e.g. `OK`).

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `armed_state` (String) For type `fencing`: whether HA is `armed`, `standby`, `disarming`, or `disarmed`.
- `auto_rebalance` (Boolean) For type `service`: whether the resource may be migrated during automatic rebalancing.
- `crm_state` (String) For type `service`: service state as seen by the CRM.
- `failback` (Boolean) For type `service`: whether the resource migrates back to a higher-priority node.
- `id` (String) Status entry ID (e.g. `quorum`, `master`, `lrm:pve1`, `service:vm:100`).
- `max_relocate` (Number) For type `service`: maximal relocate tries.
- `max_restart` (Number) For type `service`: maximal restart tries on a node.
- `node` (String) Node associated with the status entry.
- `quorate` (Boolean) For type `quorum`: whether the cluster is quorate.
- `request_state` (String) For type `service`: requested service state.
- `resource_mode` (String) For type `fencing`: how resources are handled while disarmed (`freeze` or `ignore`).
- `sid` (String) For type `service`: HA resource ID.
- `state` (String) For type `service`: verbose service state.
- `status` (String) Status of the entry (value depends on the type).
- `timestamp` (Number) For types `lrm` and `master`: timestamp of the status information.
- `type` (String) Entry type: `quorum`, `master`, `lrm`, `service`, or `fencing`.
